name: com.gamecore.gameplay.inventory
description: Catalog row 8 of the gameplay plugin library (P1.4): items and economy. Authoring: ItemDefinition, InventoryDefinition, VendorDefinition, LootTableDefinition and WorldItemDefinition. Kernel half: inventory and vendor targets with the inv.item.<k>/inv.count.<k>/inv.currency slots and a request ring, world item targets with item.taken, the inventory.grant (idempotent by request id), consume, drop, transfer, buy, sell and pickup routes and the ItemGranted/ItemConsumed/ItemDropped/ItemTransferred/TradeDone/InventoryFull/ItemPickedUp events. Runtime: InventoryCommands, InventoryPresenter (IInventoryView), WorldItemBinder (pickup through the action ref inventory.pickup) and VendorBinder. Editor: inventory.grantStarting, placeItem and setStock.
